title: Cat 320D Operator Controls Tour
source: generated from the Cat 320D Operation and Maintenance Manual (SEBU8053-20)

segments.caption: Cat 320D Operator Controls
segments.transcript: This is a tour of the operator controls of the Cat 320D excavator, taken from its Operation and Maintenance Manual.

segments.caption: The cab · manual page 95
segments.transcript: Here is the cab from above. Each control has a number in the manual. Pause at any time and ask Cat about what you see.

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls

segments.caption: (1a) Air Conditioning and Heater Control · manual page 96
segments.transcript: The heater and air-conditioner keep the operator comfortable in both hot and cold conditions.

controls.name: Air Conditioning and Heater Control
controls.looks_like: climate control panel with a small digital display and fan and AUTO buttons, rear of the right console
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Air Conditioning and Heating Control (1a - 1b)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Air Conditioning and Heating Control (1a - 1b)

segments.caption: (1b) Air Conditioning and Heater Control · manual page 96
segments.transcript: The heater and air-conditioner keep the operator comfortable while working in a range of temperature conditions.

controls.name: Air Conditioning and Heater Control
controls.looks_like: small climate buttons on the left console, beside the seat
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Air Conditioning and Heating Control (1a - 1b)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Air Conditioning and Heating Control (1a - 1b)

segments.caption: (2) Hydraulic Lockout Control · manual page 96
segments.transcript: The hydraulic lockout lever sits on the left side of the left console; pulling it back locks all factory-installed hydraulic controls, while pushing it forward unlocks them for operation.

controls.name: Hydraulic Lockout Control
controls.looks_like: hydraulic lockout lever on the left console, left of the seat
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Hydraulic Lockout Control (2)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Hydraulic Lockout Control (2)

segments.caption: (3) Travel Controls · manual page 96
segments.transcript: When traveling, keep the final drive sprockets beneath the rear of the machine; releasing the travel levers or pedals returns them to center and applies the travel brakes.

controls.name: Travel Controls
controls.looks_like: two long travel levers with foot pedals, in front of the seat
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Controls (3)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Controls (3)

segments.caption: (3) Travel Controls · manual page 96
segments.transcript: Move both travel levers or pedals equally in the same direction to travel straight.

controls.name: Travel Controls
controls.looks_like: two long travel levers with foot pedals, in front of the seat
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Controls (3)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Controls (3)

segments.caption: (4) Service Hour Meter · manual page 98
segments.transcript: This display shows the total operating hours of the engine. Use it to work out the service hour maintenance intervals.

controls.name: Service Hour Meter
controls.looks_like: service hour meter on the front right pillar, near the monitor
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Service Hour Meter (4)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Service Hour Meter (4)

segments.caption: (5) Monitor · manual page 98
segments.transcript: The monitor displays various operating information about the machine. The Monitoring System section of the manual explains how to use it.

controls.name: Monitor
controls.looks_like: monitor screen, front right of the cab
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Monitor (5)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Monitor (5)

segments.caption: (6) Joystick Controls · manual page 98
segments.transcript: The joystick control operates the work-tool functions, with detailed individual joystick functions described elsewhere in the manual.

controls.name: Joystick Controls
controls.looks_like: joystick handle on the right console (the left one mirrors it)
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Joystick Controls (6)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Joystick Controls (6)

segments.caption: (7) Engine Speed Control · manual page 98
segments.transcript: Turn the engine speed dial clockwise to increase rpm or counter-clockwise to decrease it, with the selected position shown on the electronic monitor panel.

controls.name: Engine Speed Control
controls.looks_like: engine speed dial, round knob on the right console
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Engine Speed Control (7)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Engine Speed Control (7)

segments.caption: (8) Engine Start Switch · manual page 99
segments.transcript: Turn the key clockwise to ON to activate all cab circuits, and on to START to crank the engine. Release the key after the engine starts. Turn it to OFF to stop the engine.

controls.name: Engine Start Switch
controls.looks_like: key switch (engine start switch) on the right console
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Engine Start Switch (8)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Engine Start Switch (8)

segments.caption: (10) Operator's Seat · manual page 99
segments.transcript: The operator's seat and console provide multiple adjustments to suit a wide range of operators.

controls.name: Operator's Seat
controls.looks_like: the operator's seat
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Operator's Seat (10)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Operator's Seat (10)

segments.caption: (11) Radio · manual page 99
segments.transcript: The 320D can be equipped with a radio; details are covered in the manual’s Radio section.

controls.name: Radio
controls.looks_like: radio, behind the seat on the right
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Radio (11)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Radio (11)

segments.caption: (12) Backup Controls (If Equipped) · manual page 99
segments.transcript: The backup switches are under the right armrest. With switch 12A in MANUAL, the electronic controller is disconnected and the monitor shows LIMITED MOBILITY MODE.

controls.name: Backup Controls (If Equipped)
controls.looks_like: backup switches under the right console cover
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Backup Controls (12) (If Equipped)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Backup Controls (12) (If Equipped)

segments.caption: (12) Backup Controls (If Equipped) · manual page 99
segments.transcript: When backup switch 12A stays in the AUTOMATIC position, the electronic controller governs engine speed and the backup switches are inactive.

controls.name: Backup Controls (If Equipped)
controls.looks_like: backup switches under the right console cover
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Backup Controls (12) (If Equipped)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Backup Controls (12) (If Equipped)

segments.caption: (9) Right side control panel · manual page 96
segments.transcript: Now the right side control panel, with switches 13 to 26.

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls

segments.caption: (13) Travel Speed Control · manual page 100
segments.transcript: Press it to choose LOW SPEED for rough or soft ground or loading onto a trailer, or AUTOMATIC for fast travel on hard, level ground. Don't change it while you travel.

controls.name: Travel Speed Control
controls.looks_like: round switch with rabbit and turtle icons, top row, first on the left
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Speed Control (13)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Speed Control (13)

segments.caption: (14) Automatic Engine Speed Control (AEC) · manual page 100
segments.transcript: The Automatic Engine Speed Control reduces engine speed when the machine is idle, helping lower fuel use, noise, and wear, and returns to the dial setting whenever a hydraulic function is activated.

controls.name: Automatic Engine Speed Control (AEC)
controls.looks_like: round switch with the AEC icon, top row, second
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Automatic Engine Speed Control (14)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Automatic Engine Speed Control (14)

segments.caption: (15) Travel Alarm Cancel Switch · manual page 101
segments.transcript: Press the Travel Alarm Cancel Switch to stop the alarm, and the indicator lamp will illuminate.

controls.name: Travel Alarm Cancel Switch
controls.looks_like: round switch with a speaker and sound waves icon, top row, third
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Alarm Cancel Switch (15)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Travel Alarm Cancel Switch (15)

segments.caption: (16) Work Tool Control · manual page 101
segments.transcript: Press the Work Tool Control switch to show the selected tool on the monitor, and press it repeatedly to cycle through the available tools.

controls.name: Work Tool Control
controls.looks_like: round switch with a work tool (hammer) icon, top row, fourth
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Work Tool Control (16)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Work Tool Control (16)

segments.caption: (17) Heavy Lift Control · manual page 101
segments.transcript: Press the button to activate heavy lift mode, which raises hydraulic relief pressure for greater lifting force and slows cylinder speed; press again to deactivate the mode.

controls.name: Heavy Lift Control
controls.looks_like: round switch with a weight and plus sign icon, bottom row, far right
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Heavy Lift Control (17)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Heavy Lift Control (17)

segments.caption: (18) Upper Window Washer · manual page 101
segments.transcript: Push the window washer switch; the indicator lights, washer fluid sprays from the nozzle, and the wiper runs while held, stopping about three seconds after release.

controls.name: Upper Window Washer
controls.looks_like: round switch with a washer spray icon, bottom row, third
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Upper Window Wiper and Window Washer (18-19)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Upper Window Wiper and Window Washer (18-19)

segments.caption: (19) Upper Window Wiper · manual page 101
segments.transcript: Press the window wiper switch once for a six-second intermittent wipe, twice for three-second intervals, three times for continuous wipe, and four times to turn it off.

controls.name: Upper Window Wiper
controls.looks_like: round switch with a wiper arc icon, bottom row, second
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Upper Window Wiper and Window Washer (18-19)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Upper Window Wiper and Window Washer (18-19)

segments.caption: (20) Light Switch · manual page 102
segments.transcript: Press the light switch once to activate Pattern 1, lighting the chassis work light D and cab lights F; press it twice for Pattern 2, adding boom light E.

controls.name: Light Switch
controls.looks_like: round switch with a lamp beam icon, bottom row, far left
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Light Switch (20)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Light Switch (20)

segments.caption: (20) Light Switch · manual page 102
segments.transcript: When both indicator lights are off, all of the work lights are turned off.

controls.name: Light Switch
controls.looks_like: round switch with a lamp beam icon, bottom row, far left
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Light Switch (20)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Light Switch (20)

segments.caption: (21) Quick Coupler Control · manual page 102
segments.transcript: Moving the switch to LOCK engages the quick coupler with the work tool, while moving it to UNLOCKED disengages the coupler and triggers an alarm.

controls.name: Quick Coupler Control
controls.looks_like: rocker switch with lock icons, first in the middle panel
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Quick Coupler Control (21)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Quick Coupler Control (21)

segments.caption: (22) Lower Window Wiper · manual page 102
segments.transcript: Push down the top of switch (22) to turn the lower window wiper on, and push down the bottom portion of the switch to turn it off.

controls.name: Lower Window Wiper
controls.looks_like: rocker switch with a wiper icon, second in the middle panel
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Lower Window Wiper and Window Washer (22-23)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Lower Window Wiper and Window Washer (22-23)

segments.caption: (23) Lower Window Washer · manual page 102
segments.transcript: Press the top of the switch and hold it down to activate the lower window washer, causing fluid to spray from the nozzle; continuous operation beyond twenty seconds may cause motor failure.

controls.name: Lower Window Washer
controls.looks_like: rocker switch with a washer icon, third in the middle panel
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Lower Window Wiper and Window Washer (22-23)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Lower Window Wiper and Window Washer (22-23)

segments.caption: (24) Seat Heater · manual page 103
segments.transcript: In cold weather, press the top of the seat-heater switch to turn it on, and push the bottom to turn it off; the thermostat disables the heater when cabin temperature exceeds 10 °C.

controls.name: Seat Heater
controls.looks_like: rocker switch with a seat heater icon, fourth in the middle panel
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Seat Heater (24)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Seat Heater (24)

segments.caption: (25) Fine Swing Control · manual page 103
segments.transcript: Fine swing delays the swing parking brake for 6.5 seconds after the swing joystick returns to neutral, so the swing drifts instead of stopping abruptly. Turn it off on a slope.

controls.name: Fine Swing Control
controls.looks_like: rocker switch with a swing icon, fifth in the middle panel
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Fine Swing Control (25) (If Equipped)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Fine Swing Control (25) (If Equipped)

segments.caption: (26) Overload Warning Device · manual page 103
segments.transcript: When lifting, it sounds a buzzer if the load is unstable; then reduce the bucket load or move the stick inward. Push the right side of the switch to turn it on.

controls.name: Overload Warning Device
controls.looks_like: rocker switch with an overload warning icon, sixth in the middle panel
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Overload Warning Device (26) (If Equipped)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Overload Warning Device (26) (If Equipped)

segments.caption: (26) Overload Warning Device · manual page 103
segments.transcript: Push the left side of the switch to turn it off.

controls.name: Overload Warning Device
controls.looks_like: rocker switch with an overload warning icon, sixth in the middle panel
controls.manual_title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Overload Warning Device (26) (If Equipped)

manual.title: Operation Section > Operator Controls > Overload Warning Device (26) (If Equipped)
